messages:
Ana: Heads up — vendor PO got rejected by the marketplace portal, stuck on billing_entity vs legal_entity mismatch. PO id 987654321. Need quick unblock, customer is pushing.
Mike: Which marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP)?
Ana: Azure marketplace. The portal validation expects the exact corporate name on the MSA, vendor sent a slightly different legal name. Portal error: 'billing_entity not registered'
Rachel: Can you paste the PO snippet?
Ana: Sure — portal logs show: 
```
{
  "po_id": "987654321",
  "billing_entity": "Redwood Inference, LLC",
  "vendor_legal_name": "Redwood Inference Inc.",
  "currency": "USD",
  "amount": 120000
}
```
Mike: Ugh, the trailing punctuation / entity type mismatch (LLC vs Inc) is the classic reject. Procurement won't accept unless names match exactly.
Tom: From legal: we can either get vendor to reissue PO with exact registered name, or add vendor alias mapping on the marketplace side. Alias mapping needs legal approval + marketplace onboarding change. Which is faster?
Rachel: Alias mapping could be faster if marketplace supports an override, but finance needs a signed attestation linking the alias to the registered entity for audit. That takes a day.
Ana: Vendor Ops — can you ping the vendor and ask for a corrected PO? @VendorOps Bot?
VendorOps Bot: @Ana pinged vendor contact (jen@vendor.com). Vendor said they can reissue but needs accounting lead on our side to confirm the correct legal name to use.
Mike: I'll forward vendor the exact line from our MSA: "Redwood Inference, Inc." — but procurement will probably still want the PO to match our W-9/contracting entity.
Rachel: Our canonical legal name in the vendor registry is "Redwood Inference, Inc." We need vendor PO to match that for payment and tax reasons. If they reissue, finance can accept immediately.
Tom: If vendor can't reissue today, I can draft a short exception notice + attestation that ties the alternate name to our entity. But marketplace marketplace-infra needs to accept an exception.
marketplace-integrations: Adding note — Azure portal accepts alias binding only through a ticketed process, SLA ~48 hours.
Ana: So two paths: vendor reissues (fastest, vendor dependent) OR marketplace alias (slower ~48h but doesn't require vendor). Customer wants asap.
Mike: I just messaged vendor accounting asking for a reissued PO with exact name. ETA?
VendorOps Bot: Vendor accounting acknowledged, ETA 6 business hours to reissue.
Rachel: If ETA is 6 hours we can patch this afternoon. I'll mark this as procurement blocker in the deal desk tracker and hold payment until PO matches.
Tom: I'll prepare a minimal attestation template in case vendor asks for a workaround.
Ana: Action items: 1) Mike — confirm vendor will reissue PO (6h). 2) Rachel — if vendor misses ETA, open alias request with Azure + attach attestation. 3) Tom — draft attestation (shared to thread). 4) Mike — drop vendor contact in SFDC.
Mike: On it. I will update thread when vendor sends new PO.
Rachel: Adding :white_check_mark: will notify procurement.
Ana: Thanks team. If vendor stalls, I'll escalate to partnerships lead.
Mike: Vendor sent preliminary ack, says reissue coming. Will post PO when received.
Ana: Good. Closing loop for now but leaving thread open until new PO lands. :mag_right:
